address: High Street, Clearwell, Royal Forest of Dean, Gloucestershire,GL16 8JS
bio: Pamper yourself with a delicious Afternoon Tea in the award-winning Tudor Farmhouse Hotel. Indulge in a selection of delectable treats from the comforts of this 13th century building that has been converted into a boutique rural retreat.  Afternoon Tea can be served in the restaurant, lounge or garden area, providing diners with the ideal environment to relax and enjoy the picturesque surroundings of this peaceful country hotel set within 14 acres of ancient grassland.  Their Afternoon Tea menu includes a number of classic features of the British tradition such as sumptuous finger sandwiches and delectable scones with clotted cream. If you are feeling in a decadent mood then there is the option to add a luxurious glass of Champagne.  The Tudor Farmhouse Hotel is situated near the Clearwell Caves in the heart of the Forest of Dean, and is just a short drive away from Coleford.
